description: Ministry of Lands & Parliament Reforms - Appoint Mr.W. M. W. Wanninayaka as an Acquiring Officer for the Central Expressway Project from 01.10.2017 to 30.09.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer under the Land Acquisition Act to function for land acquisitions related to the Central Expressway Project. The content focuses on property acquisition procedures and authority assignments for land matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
